newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-MATCHES AT THE WEEKEND IN THE SPANISH FIRST DIVISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MATCHES AT THE WEEKEND IN THE SPANISH FIRST DIVISION.

text.p: Matches scheduled for this weekend in the Spanish first division: (league standings in brackets, kick off times gmt)
Saturday:
Celta Vigo (13) vs Valladolid (8) kick off 1700 gmt
Valladolid's Jose Quevedo will fill in for injured Croatian striker Alen Peternac as 1996's surprise outfit hope to get a good start to the new year.
Deportivo Coruna (3) vs Barcelona (2) 1930
New Deportivo signing Renaldo hopes to make his debut against compatriot Ronaldo, star of a Barcelona side which will miss another Brazilian, Giovanni, for the weekend's big game.
Sunday:
Rayo Vallecano (12) vs Sevilla (20) 1100
Bebeto has added to dressing-room tension at struggling Sevilla by returning home late from Brazil ahead of a game in which his side desperately need to come home with three points.
Espanyol (14) vs Compostela (17) 1100
Both sides were more than 10 places higher this time last year and are looking to put things right.
Extremadura (22) vs Atletico Madrid (6) 1600
Romanian defender Daniel Prodan is set to make his debut in a game the Spanish champions desperately need to win to close the six-point gap on the leading group.
Hercules (21) vs Sporting (16) 1600
Hercules look set to leave out Croatian defender Dubravko Pavlicic, who has been disciplined for missing the team's New Year dinner, ahead of a game both sides badly need to win.
Oviedo (15) vs Logrones (18) 1600
Oviedo manager Juan Manuel Lillo must look for replacements for injured defenders Cesar Martin and Mitko Stojkovski against struggling Logrones.
Racing Santander (10) vs Tenerife (9) 1600
Tenerife have Bosnian forward Meho Kodro and midfielder Dani Gonzalez back from injury against a Racing team who tend to keep their best performances for games away from home.
Real Sociedad (6) vs Zaragoza (19) 1600
Dressing-room conflict surrounds the game after Real's Juan Gomez arrived late from holiday, while fellow Argentine Kily Gonzalez has been fined by Zaragoza for missing training.
Real Madrid (1) vs Athletic Bilbao (7) 1830
Athletic won at Real last season and hope to repeat the feat against Fabio Capello's leaders, who may be without key central defender Rafael Alkorta.
Monday:
Real Betis (4) vs Valencia (11) 2030
Betis need to keep up the pressure at the top by scoring their 400th win in the first division against an injury-wracked Valencia side likely to take the field with just one striker.
